books.why_zh: 在美国自身极化的当下，读一部把「两个美国」写成一确二真的小说——现实已经在分叉，小说只是把它显影。
books.why_en: In a moment of American fracturing, a novel that writes "two Americas" as one-true-two — reality is already forking; fiction only develops the film.

background.zh: 曼德尔 2026 年的第七部长篇，也是她最政治化的作品。2031 年一场政变后美国分崩离析为互战的共和国、城邦与民兵地盘（A 面，混乱）；同书并置一个从未分裂、却收缩为铁腕监控国家的「美利坚合众国」（B 面，极权）。两个美国由一场洛杉矶派对事故与一幅 1968 年的画作《天鹅潜水》（Swan Dive）相连。A 面的混乱与 B 面的秩序互为「国家的反生活」，也是作者对「半数选民在基本事实上都不再一致」的当下焦虑的直接投影。曼德尔自称「最政治、最酷儿、最好的小说」。
background.en: Mandel's seventh novel and her most openly political. After a 2031 coup the U.S. splinters into warring republics/city-states and militia zones (A-Side, chaos); a parallel America never fragments but constricts into a surveillance state run by the "Service" (B-Side). The two are bridged by a party accident and a 1968 painting, "Swan Dive." Chaos and totalitarianism function as a "dark twinship" — the counterlife of the state — mirroring Mandel's anxiety that "half the electorate disagrees on basic reality." She calls it "my most political work, my most queer work, I think it's my best novel."

plot_acts.zh: 2031 年春——美国政变崩解后的「第一个春天」。国际维和部队撤离洛杉矶，宵禁随《萨克拉门托协定》解除，加州共和国成立。48 岁的阿里·韦克刚出狱（18 年刑期，雇凶杀害表兄安东）。她与室友格洛丽亚穿过棚户区、红十字帐篷与炸弹嗅探犬去银湖参加卡里姆·法耶德的派对。派对上「出了毛病」：塞拉亚的第二个版本（穿便装的困惑女人）现身又逃入夜色；自称尼科的「第二个格洛丽亚」闯入厨房；主人卡里姆在一间没有外门的厨房里凭空消失。格洛丽亚取下画作《天鹅潜水》带画赴欧洲（她怀着卡里姆的孩子）。事后有人对阿里说：「我想，那场派对也是一扇门。」
plot_acts.en: In the first spring after the collapse of the United States, peacekeepers withdraw from LA, the curfew is lifted (Sacramento Accord), the Republic of California is declared. Ari Waker, 48, is newly released after 18 years for hiring a hit on her cousin. She walks with roommate Gloria to Kareem Fayed's Silverlake party past tent cities and bomb-sniffing dogs. At the flower-filled party "there's something wrong": a second, casually dressed Saraya appears and flees; a woman entering the kitchen; the host Kareem vanishes from a doorless kitchen. Gloria takes the painting and flees to Europe, pregnant. "I think the party was also a door."

plot_acts.zh: 阿里在崩解的 A 面世界漂泊求生：洛杉矶街头当洗碗工/零售店员；东迁俄亥俄共和国，为饯行组织做杂役、替民兵头目爱德华多跟踪尼科；与曾是芭蕾舞者的军火商费利克斯结伴南下得克萨斯，再逃往欧洲（巴黎圆顶孤城、希腊军火商据点）。她后来甩掉费利克斯，与雇佣兵比尔·索里亚诺结成交易式联盟，最终化名巴黎艺术藏家「阿里·索里亚诺」。她天生的预感（clairvoyance）时灵时不灵。核心台词：「若没有人见证，你的过去就开始像虚构。」
plot_acts.en: Ari drifts through the broken A-Side world: dishwashing/retail in LA, militia work in the Ohio Republic (surveilling Nico for Eduardo), a partnership with Felix (a former ballet dancer turned gunrunner), flight through Texas to Europe (domed Paris, a Greek militia hangout), a transactional alliance with mercenary Bill Soriano, and finally a life as Paris art collector "Ari Soriano." Her premonitions are unreliable. Motto-line: "If you don't have a witness, your past starts to feel fictional."

plot_acts.zh: B 面：合众国没有崩解，却成了极权国家——「Service」（内部安全局）当街掳人，劳动营供「批评政府者」改造；投票不再必需，总统之位预定由他儿子接任。UCLA 四名物理学家——尼科·李、丈夫卡里姆·法耶德、塞拉亚·德·桑托斯与同事莱恩——深夜秘密做传送实验：先用《天鹅潜水》试机（完美传送），随后卡里姆踏上平台，被复制成两个——B 面出现两个卡里姆，均被 Service 羁押；同时 A 面派对上的卡里姆在厨房消失。阿里的 B 面对应体是资深探员伊巴里·韦克：公开职业是城市规划讲师；鼻梁上一副银胶带修补的眼镜可骗过人脸识别；她自称「我一生都带着一点点直觉」。她用假名「大卫·格里森」（《歌者之枪》旧角色）救出 A 面卡里姆。
plot_acts.en: B-Side America stayed whole — and constricted: the "Service" yanks people into unmarked cars, labor camps reform critics, voting is no longer required. Four UCLA physicists (Nico Li, her husband Kareem Fayed, Saraya de Santos, colleague Len) secretly run a teleportation experiment; "Swan Dive" transmits perfectly, then Kareem steps on the platform and is duplicated — two Kareems, both detained. Ari's parallel is Ibari Waker, senior Service detective whose cover is urban-planning professor; her silver-taped glasses defeat facial recognition. She frees the A-side Kareem under the alias "David Grissom" (a Singer's Gun character).

plot_acts.zh: 故事跨越数十年。巴黎在对世界其余部分关闭的圆顶内成为相对安稳的孤岛（约 2065 年前后）。格洛丽亚是不尽责的母亲；尼科成为塞巴斯蒂安（格洛丽亚与 A 面卡里姆之子）的代理母亲；《天鹅潜水》经手多人。塞巴斯蒂安 20 岁决定把画从年迈藏家阿里·索里亚诺处「偷回」，作为给尼科的生日礼物；阿里在巴黎文森森林追逐画作时被劫匪重创。B 面：获释的卡里姆患癌临终，成年的萨米尔（月面殖民地建筑师）与马洛（传送物理学家、患有「时间线损坏」式的复杂 PTSD）守于床边；另一个卡里姆翻窗而入与他道别。动身退休的伊巴里（79 岁）行使「火化权」销毁追踪编码、下载国家机密档案交给抵抗组织，随后独自走进太平洋。
plot_acts.en: The novel arcs across decades into a domed-Paris refuge (circa 2065) sealed off from the broken world. Gloria is a neglectful mother; Nico is a surrogate mother to Sebastian (Gloria's son by the party Kareem). Sebastian, at 20, decides to steal "Swan Dive" back from elderly collector Ari Soriano as a birthday present for Nico; Ari is badly hurt chasing him through the Bois de Vincennes. B-Side: the freed Kareem dies of cancer with grown Samir (architect on the lunar colony) and Marlowe (a transport physicist wracked by complex PTSD — "timeline corruption") at his bedside; the other Kareem climbs in a window to say goodbye. Retiring Ibari (79) uses her "right of incineration," destroys her trackers, copies the State's files to the Resistance, then walks into the Pacific surf.

plot_acts.zh: 尾声不以乌托邦收束，而以「一丝希望的微光」收束：艺术的长寿与「短暂即甜蜜」互为支撑；「如果世上没有见证者，你的过去就开始像虚构」一语回收。曼德尔强调这是「希望之书」，是疫情后纽约那个奇迹般盛夏的「desperate joy」所驱动。
plot_acts.en: The ending declines utopia for "a little glimmer of hope": art outliving makers and countries is the governing theme; "temporary brings its own kind of sweetness" recurs. Mandel insists this is a hopeful book born of the "desperate joy" of New York's magical pandemic-era summer.

narrative.zh: 全书三部分——A-Side（A 面/混乱宇宙）、B-Side（B 面/极权宇宙）、Swan Dive（《天鹅潜水》：近卷末的短章，交代画作 1968 年在纽约公寓的缘起）。整体第三人称叙述，部分段落转为现在时；章节内嵌标题小节（如「The Birthday Present」「True Diligence」）；含审讯转录稿——其中一段是「只听一方」的独角转录，书评人指为炫技。双镜结构：A/B 两面的对应人物互为「反生活」，以跨世界重复的句子与意象缝合全书（「我想跳进海里，一路游过那片蓝」「真正的勤奋=追随不可能之路」「PTSD 是时间线损坏」）。机制几乎不给解释——可穿点疑似为「同时存在于两个宇宙的物体」（画作），而书内尼科自嘲「我觉得那幅画是个障眼法」。
narrative.en: Three parts — A-Side, B-Side, and a late, short "Swan Dive" section on the painting's 1968 New York origins. Third person throughout (present tense in stretches); embedded titled micro-chapters; an interrogation transcript, plus a famously one-sided "transcript" chapter that critics call showy. The doubled worlds braid via mirror-selves and repeated lines/images. The physics is deliberately unexplained — "a notion that objects might be where parallel universes converge" — undercut in-text by Nico: "I think the painting's a red herring."

quotes.orig: An idea that I've been fascinated with for a long time is this notion of the counterlife, the life you didn't live.
quotes.trans_zh: 「反生活」（counterlife）这个念头我着迷已久——那些你未曾活过的生活。

quotes.orig: It's interesting to think about the counterlife of the individual, but it's also interesting to think about the counterlife of the state.
quotes.trans_zh: 想象个体的反生活很有意思，但想想「国家的反生活」也耐人寻味。

quotes.orig: I've never been particularly interested in disaster, but I am interested in its aftermath. There's hope in thinking about the world that follows catastrophic events.
quotes.trans_zh: 我对「灾难」本身从不特别感兴趣，我感兴趣的是灾难之后的事。想象大灾后的世界，其中是有希望的。

quotes.orig: Who will you be at the end of the world? I think of that as the book's central question.
quotes.trans_zh: 「世界落幕时你会成为怎样的人？」——我认为这是全书的核心之问。

quotes.orig: That feeling of desperate joy at the end of the world, that was something I was really trying to capture… There is a lot of joy even in these incredibly compromised times.
quotes.trans_zh: 「世界尽头的绝望之乐」正是我想抓住的……哪怕在如此千疮百孔的时代，也仍有大量快乐。

quotes.orig: The collapse of consensual reality. When you get to a situation where half the electorate disagrees on basic reality… I don't know how you come back from that.
quotes.trans_zh: 共识性现实的坍塌。当半数选民连最基本的事实都达不成一致……我不知道这该怎么弥合。

intent.reception_good_zh: Kirkus——「自《大站十一》以来最好的作品……把平行时间线的概念天才地接上政治主题」；Booklist、Library Journal 星评；Publishers Weekly ★「tour de force」。NPR 的 Corrigan 说「派对值得等待」；New Yorker 的 Waldman 自称「一口读完」；Boston Globe「曼德尔最好的状态」；Saturday Paper「精彩、完全笃定」。
intent.reception_good_en: Kirkus — "best since Station Eleven… brilliantly ties parallel timelines to a political theme"; Booklist & Library Journal starred; PW ★ "tour de force." NPR's Corrigan: the party "is worth the wait"; The New Yorker's Waldman "gulped it down"; Boston Globe: "Mandel at her best."
intent.reception_bad_zh: 反面/保留：Irish Examiner ——情节「unwieldy（笨重）」、结尾「陷入混乱」；Goodreads 1.5★ 博客则骂前提拉仲；BookAndFilmGlobe「圆满收束但非解决」；New Yorker 亦点出主角群「each seem to represent a different ethnic group」的危险——近乎零风险的讨好式演员名单。文学评论（Literary Review of Canada, 2026-10）正文未取到（○）。
intent.reception_bad_en: Dissent: Irish Examiner calls the plot "unwieldy" and the climax "descends into confusion"; a 1.5★ Goodreads blog resents stretched premises; BookAndFilmGlobe: "satisfying closure but not resolution." The New Yorker flags the "attractive prodigies" who "each seem to represent a different ethnic group." Literary Review of Canada, 2026-10 unretrieved (○).
intent.syn_zh: 作者明确把书写成「关于余波而非灾难」的希望之书，同时它是警世书：监控调性之外，「当半国选民不信基本事实」才是她笔下两个世界共同的原初创伤。主流书评盛赞居多；质疑集中在结构炫技与中段巴黎的拖沓。
intent.syn_en: Mandel frames the book as about aftermaths, not disasters, while warning that fractured consensus reality is the root trauma of both worlds. Mainstream reception is largely rapturous (Kirkus: "best since Station Eleven"), with dissent on pacing and the showy transcripts.

craft.zh: 画作作纽带——一幅《天鹅潜水》串起 A/B 两面与十余年幕：艺术是「最古老的时间旅行器」，延续《大站十一》的漫画即契约母题。
craft.en: The painting as thread — "Swan Dive" ties A/B sides across decades; art is "the oldest time machine," continuing Station Eleven's comics-as-covenant motif.

craft.zh: A/B=唱片 AB 面——双面结构取黑胶语义，「无须对称」；B 面机械的和谐反写 A 面随机的枪火。
craft.en: A/B updates an LP's sides — "you don't demand symmetry"; B-side's mechanical harmony inverts A-side's random fire.

craft.zh: 重复句缝合世界——跨世界重复的句子制造「既视感的惊悚」（"I want to dive into the ocean and keep swimming through the blue"; "True diligence means following the improbable path"）。
craft.en: Repeated sentences across worlds create déjà-vu dread, reading the two worlds as one coin.

craft.zh: 零科学软科幻——机制从不解释：「如果书里有时间机器，我不会告诉你怎么运作」，重点在人。
craft.en: "If there's a time machine in my book, I'm not going to tell you how it works" — the physics stays unexplainable.

craft.zh: PTSD=时间线损坏——用科幻概念映射日常心理损伤，是全书的微缩模型。
craft.en: "PTSD is timeline corruption" compresses the novel's theme into an aphorism.

craft.zh: 酷儿与照护——与早期作品相比，「做母亲」上升为核心情感（女儿 2015 年出生后她自认才懂某些细微差别）；阿里的双性恋被无戏剧化地正面写出。
craft.en: Parenthood became a core emotional register after her daughter's 2015 birth; Ari's bisexuality is stated without drama.

motifs.name_en: party as door / doorway and faction
motifs.evid_zh: 全书钥匙母题：派对既是字面的门（无外门的厨房），也是宇宙论的门（物体是平行世界相交之处）；「party」兼指社交聚会与政治党派——一个词承载两重灾难（国家碎裂 vs 极权收束）。开场的洛杉矶夜景里，「一身银裙、褶如锡箔」的女子在派对上出现为一重分裂的预兆。
motifs.evid_en: The book's hinge-motif: the party is a literal door (the kitchen with no door) and a cosmological one (objects as the convergences of parallel universes); "party" doubles as social gathering and political faction — one word, two collapses.
motifs.orig: I think the party was also a door.

motifs.name_zh: 天鹅潜水 · 画作纽带
motifs.name_en: Swan Dive — the painting as thread
motifs.evid_zh: 跨作品之物：《天鹅潜水》早在《玻璃旅馆》（2019）出场，在此成为情节枢纽——既是私人物品史，也印证「艺术比承载它的人与国更长寿」；作者称艺术是「最古老的时间旅行器」，延续《大站十一》的漫画即契约母题（结构无损层的 cross-text object）。
motifs.evid_en: A cross-book object: "Swan Dive" first appeared in The Glass Hotel (2019) and is central here — a micro-history of art outliving people and nations, the "oldest time machine," continuing Station Eleven's art-as-covenant motif.
motifs.orig: The painting, "Swan Dive," first appeared in The Glass Hotel (2019), and is central to the plot here.

motifs.name_en: jacaranda — beauty on its own calendar
motifs.evid_zh: 开篇第一句的景象母题：被战争、宵禁与维和部队撤军标记的「第一个春天」，由一棵南美外来树的气味打开——灾难下的美不来自国家，而来自仍按时开花的东西。
motifs.evid_en: The opening-image motif: the "first spring" after the collapse is opened by a smell, not by the state — a South American import that keeps to its own calendar.
motifs.orig: In the first spring after the collapse of the United States, the blossoming of the jacaranda trees felt to Ari like grace.

motifs.name_zh: 国家的反生活 · 两版美国
motifs.name_en: counterlife of the state — two versions of the country
motifs.evid_zh: 比喻由人滑向国家：不只个人有分身的「反生活」，国家也有——一个世界「碎裂成一片狼藉」，另一个「收缩成一只拳头」；无序的散开与压抑的收束，两极同源。
motifs.evid_en: The simile slides from persons to the country: one world "fractured into disarray," the other "closed like a fist" — a civilization's dystopia and a police state's, shaped by the same fear.
motifs.orig: There was a world where my homeland had fractured into disarray, and another where my homeland had closed like a fist.

motifs.name_zh: 和谐不惜代价 · 监控即服务
motifs.name_en: harmony at any cost — surveillance as Service
motifs.evid_zh: B 面极权的排比宣言：「混乱的对立面是和谐；和平靠监控达成；服务局即国家的监控部门；不惜代价的和谐」。把监控委婉命名为「Service」，秩序被定义为混乱的对立面——而非混沌与自由。
motifs.evid_en: The B-side manifesto in tetracolon: order as the opposite of disorder, not of chaos and freedom — surveillance rebranded as "Service," harmony at any cost.
motifs.orig: The opposite of disorder is harmony. Peace is achieved through surveillance. Service is the surveillance department of the State. Harmony at any cost.

motifs.name_zh: 见证公信 · 无证即虚构
motifs.name_en: witness — without a witness, the past turns fictional
motifs.evid_zh: 全书母题最凝缩的一句（也是本仓「witness-aesthetics」术语的源头）：没有见证者，记忆就失去公信力——个人如此，国家亦然，史学即见证。
motifs.evid_en: The tersest statement of the book's core concern: without a witness the past loses all standing — true of persons, true of countries. History is testimony, or it is fiction.
motifs.orig: If you don't have a witness, your past starts to feel fictional.

excerpts.orig: In the first spring after the collapse of the United States, the blossoming of the jacaranda trees felt to Ari like grace.
excerpts.trans_zh: 在美国崩塌之后的第一个春天，蓝花楹的盛放于阿里而言，如同恩典。
excerpts.trans_en: In the first spring after the collapse of the United States, the blossoming of the jacaranda trees felt to Ari like grace.
excerpts.note_zh: 「白莲木/蓝花楹」点燃的是春天——南美洲原生、被引进洛杉矶的树，花在干热的五月盛放成片紫云。一个被战争、宵禁与维和部队撤军标记的「第一个春天」，却由这棵外来树的气味打开：灾难之下的美，不来自宏大的国家，而来自仍按时开花的东西。
excerpts.note_en: The jacaranda — a South American native imported into Los Angeles — erupts in purple in the dry May heat. The "first spring" after the collapse is opened by a smell, not by the state: beauty that keeps to its own calendar. Note the past-simple precision — one clause, no flourish — pure Mandel.

excerpts.orig: I think the party was also a door. / There's something wrong with the party. / There were extra people.
excerpts.trans_zh: 我想，那场派对也是一扇门。/ 派对上出了毛病。/ 那里有额外的人。
excerpts.trans_en: I think the party was also a door. / There's something wrong with the party. / There were extra people.
excerpts.note_zh: 全书的钥匙句：「门」既是字面的（无外门的厨房），也是宇宙论的（物体是平行宇宙相交之处）。「有额外的人」——party 在这里带着双重语义：既指派对，也指政治党派。一个词承担两重灾难。
excerpts.note_en: The hinge-line of the whole book: "door" is literal (the kitchen with no door) and cosmological (objects as the convergence of parallel universes). And "party" doubles: a social party and a political party — one word, two collapses.

excerpts.orig: The opposite of disorder is harmony. Peace is achieved through surveillance. Service is the surveillance department of the State. Harmony at any cost.
excerpts.trans_zh: 混乱的对立面是和谐；和平靠监控达成；服务局即国家的监控部门；不惜一切代价的和谐。
excerpts.trans_en: The opposite of disorder is harmony. Peace is achieved through surveillance. Service is the surveillance department of the State. Harmony at any cost.
excerpts.note_zh: 极权宣言式的排比。「Service」（服务局）一词的官僚委婉：把监控称作「为维持和谐服务」。四个短句，一句比一句紧，最后落到「Harmony at any cost」——不惜代价的和谐，即不择手段。
excerpts.note_en: A manifesto in tetracolon — each clause tightening toward "Harmony at any cost." The bureaucratic euphemism at work: surveillance rebranded as "Service"; order as the opposite of disorder, not of chaos and freedom.

excerpts.orig: Strange to think there weren't just two versions of me, and two versions of Kareem and Nico and possibly everyone else, but two versions of our country. There was a world where my homeland had fractured into disarray, and another where my homeland had closed like a fist.
excerpts.trans_zh: 奇怪的是，不只是我有两个版本，卡里姆、尼科乃至每个人都可能有两个版本——不，是我们国家有两个版本：一个世界里故土碎裂成一片狼藉，另一个世界里故土收缩成一只拳头。
excerpts.trans_en: Strange to think there weren't just two versions of me, and two versions of Kareem and Nico and possibly everyone else, but two versions of our country. There was a world where my homeland had fractured into disarray, and another where my homeland had closed like a fist.
excerpts.note_zh: 「国家的反生活」的点题之笔：比喻由人滑向国家——「碎裂成一片狼藉」与「收缩成一只拳头」。「fractured / closed like a fist」：无序的散开与压抑的收束，两极同源。
excerpts.note_en: The motif-line of the "counterlife of the state": the simile slides from persons (two versions of me) to the country. "Fractured into disarray" vs "closed like a fist" — a civilization's dystopia and a police state's, equally shaped by the same fear.

excerpts.orig: I have spent my whole life pulling pins on grenades… I want extremity. I want annihilation. I want to blow up my life and remake it, but how many times do you get to do that?
excerpts.trans_zh: 我这一辈子都在拔手榴弹的保险栓……我想要极端，想要湮灭，想炸掉我的人生重新来过——可这种事，人能有几次？
excerpts.trans_en: I have spent my whole life pulling pins on grenades… I want extremity. I want annihilation. I want to blow up my life and remake it, but how many times do you get to do that?
excerpts.note_zh: 伊巴里（B 面探员）的自白：把人生过成反复拔保险栓。「blow up my life and remake it」——「blow up」兼有引爆与重塑两义。反生活视角下，毁灭即重造。
excerpts.note_en: Ibari's confession: a life lived as pulling pins. "Blow up" is wonderfully ambiguous — detonate and reimagine at once. Under the counterlife lens, destruction is the price of remaking.

excerpts.orig: If you don't have a witness, your past starts to feel fictional.
excerpts.trans_zh: 若是没有人见证，你的过去就开始变得像虚构。
excerpts.trans_en: If you don't have a witness, your past starts to feel fictional.
excerpts.note_zh: 全书母题最凝缩的一句（亦是本板块术语架 witness-aesthetics 的源头）：没有见证者，记忆就失去公信力。个人如此，国家亦然——史学即见证。
excerpts.note_en: The tersest statement of the book's core concern and the seed of this domain's "witness-aesthetics" term: without a witness the past loses all standing — true of persons, true of countries. History is testimony, or it is fiction.

deep_read.zh: 把 A/B 两面当作「同一焦虑的两种结局」来读，而非平行世界解谜：逐句捕捉跨面的镜像句与镜像人物（Ari/Ibari、格洛丽亚/尼科、双卡里姆、萨米尔/马洛、费利克斯/爱德华多）。
deep_read.en: Read A/B as twin outcomes of one anxiety, tracking mirror-sentences and mirror-selves (Ari/Ibari, Gloria/Nico, the two Kareems, Samir/Marlowe) rather than solving the portal.

deep_read.zh: 逐一到路追踪《天鹅潜水》的每一次转手（派对墙→格洛丽亚→塞巴斯蒂安→尼科→伊巴里）：这是一部私人物品史，也印证「艺术比承载它的人与国更长寿」的主题。
deep_read.en: Map every hand-off of "Swan Dive" — a micro-history of art outliving people and nations, Mandel's central thesis.

deep_read.zh: 注意文体异色：审讯转录、独角转录、1968 年画作前史。作者坦承在「神秘但不令人抓狂地困惑」上走钢丝；The Leftovers（剧集）提供氛围参照。
deep_read.en: Watch the formal oddities (interrogation/one-sided transcripts, the 1968 origin chapter) against her stated tightrope — "mysterious, but not maddeningly confusing" — with The Leftovers as tonal precedent.

deep_read.zh: 预兆的「失灵」是自嘲的传记性投射（「我绝对无法预测大流行病」）——别把超自然当答案，答案在「见证」与照护里。
deep_read.en: Treat Ari's premonitions as wry self-portrait ("I absolutely cannot predict pandemics") — the answer is witness and care, not psi.

background.zh: 瓦尔加《亚当斯贝格探案》第 11 卷，2026 年 4 月 8 日由 Flammarion 出版（528 页）。书名 « Une unique lueur »（一束唯一的光）取自内瓦尔《El Desdichado》名句，与全书的核心谜面直接挂钩。注意：2026 年另有同名异书（另一作者的同名小说），须以 Flammarion 本与 Adamsberg 线索区隔。此前的二手梗概（Fraixen 老翁、斯宾诺莎时代、1980 档案、自杀调查局）经检索均未见于任何权威源——判为证伪锚点，一律不录入；确证在书内的元素：街头「完美」女尸（银莲花、金哨）、内瓦尔《El Desdichado》、白考尔/鲍嘉形象、六年前的悬案翻查、记忆-复诵主题，以及全书多语种页注。
background.en: Adamsberg #11, published by Flammarion on 8 April 2026 (528 pp). The title "Une unique lueur" — one single glimmer — is taken from Nerval's El Desdichado and keys the whole enigma. Caution: another same-titled novel by a different author also appeared in 2026; distinguish by the Flammarion imprint and the Adamsberg series. Earlier secondhand plot anchors (Fraixen, the Spinoza era, 1980 archives, a suicide-investigations bureau) were falsified by search — none appear in any authoritative source, so they are not recorded. Confirmed in-book elements: the "perfect" corpse (anemones, golden whistle), Nerval's El Desdichado, the Bacall/Bogart imagery, re-opening of a six-year-old case, the memory-repetition theme, and the book's multi-language page notes.

plot_acts.zh: 巴黎街头发现一具被精心「造型」的年轻女性尸体：格纹套装、精致妆容、身旁银莲花、颈间金色哨子——谋杀被塑造成一场美学作品。亚当斯贝格（Adamsberg）直觉嗅到这不是普通的凶案，而是一种「图像生成」：凶手按某个文学/电影范本把受害者「酿」成偶像化身。
plot_acts.en: A young woman's body is found on a Paris street, meticulously "styled": skirt suit, precise make-up, anemones at her side, a golden whistle at her throat — murder staged as a work of art. Adamsberg senses this is not an ordinary killing but image-making: the killer is "composing" victims into icons according to a literary/film template.
plot_acts.conf: ◐ (概要；核心意象与公开评论一致)
plot_acts.sources: fr 媒体书评综合 · lemondedupolar · dequoilire

plot_acts.zh: 调查通向内瓦尔《El Desdichado》（「孤毁者、鳏夫、无可慰藉者」）——书名「一束唯一的光」正出自该诗；另一条线索是白考尔（Lauren Bacall）与鲍嘉（Bogart）的电影形象。凶手把女性「排演」进偶像崇拜的构图里：文学与电影不是线索，而是他的世界观本身。
plot_acts.en: The case converges on Nerval's El Desdichado ("the dark one, the widower, the disconsolate") — the novel's title is lifted from it — and on the Bacall/Bogart film iconography. The killer stages women inside an idolatrous composition: literature and film are not clues, they are his worldview.
plot_acts.sources: 公开评论确认 Nerval/El Desdichado/白考尔/鲍嘉为在场元素

plot_acts.zh: 同一手法指向六年前一起不了了之的悬案。亚当斯贝格执意把两案并卷——「记忆-复诵」的母题（人物反复重述、行走、绕圈）成了解开谜题的关键。全书的页下注释多语种并置，呼应语言的边界与迷思的迁移。
plot_acts.en: The same method points back to a six-year-old cold case. Adamsberg insists on rejoining the two files — and the novel's memory-repetition motif (characters who repeat, walk, circle) becomes the key. Multi-language page notes mirror how words and delusions migrate across borders.

narrative.zh: 延续 Adam 系列标志性的「直觉破案」：标靶式轻描淡写的人物速写、突然的闪回、以及让调查显得玄学的闲笔。叙事节奏在 vargas 式「预感」与冷硬现实探案之间摆动；书内引文与页注承担大量互文谜面（多语种）。
narrative.en: Classic Adamsberg intuition-led detection: shorthand character sketches, sudden flashbacks, throwaway lines that make detection look like divination. The narration swings between Vargas-style "hunch" and hard police procedure; quotations and (multi-language) page notes carry much of the intertext.

intent.reception_good_zh: 法语书评普遍侧重「标题取内瓦尔《El Desdichado》『一束唯一的光』」的互文设计；认为本作延续 Vargas 对直觉-理性的辩证，是代表性的 Adamsberg 长篇。
intent.reception_good_en: French reviews focus on the Nerval title-echo and welcome another trademark Adamsberg meditation on intuition vs. reason.
intent.reception_bad_zh: 个别读感：历来被诟病的「结局玄学化」在本作依旧；中段对记忆主题的复诵被认为略有自我重复。
intent.reception_bad_en: Recurring complaints persist: the finales feel quasi-mystical; the memory-repetition theme risks sounding self-referential.
intent.syn_zh: 作者把「美学化的暴力」摆成谜面本身——文学与影像不是装饰，而是凶手看世界的镜头。书名即答案的一半。
intent.syn_en: The novel makes aestheticized violence the enigma itself — literature and film aren't décor but the killer's lens. The title is half the answer.

excerpts.orig: «Je suis le ténébreux, — le veuf, — l'inconsolé.» (Nerval, «El Desdichado»)
excerpts.trans_zh: 「我乃幽冥者，——鳏夫，——无可慰藉者。」——书名及谜面的源文本。
excerpts.source: fr.wikipedia · 公开评论确认在书内被引用
excerpts.trans_en: "I am the dark one — the widower — the inconsolable one." (Gérard de Nerval, "El Desdichado")
excerpts.note_zh: 书名《Une unique lueur》（一束独光）正脱胎于这首诗。「ténébreux / veuf / inconsolé」三连呼，是法国浪漫主义最著名的一句——诗人以失星者自喻（「我的唯一的星已经熄灭」）。瓦尔加借这句诗把罪案谜面沉入法国文学传统的底色：一束光，在黑暗中辨认。
excerpts.note_en: The novel's title quotes this line from Nerval's great sonnet "El Desdichado" — "my one Star is dead." Three vocatives (dark one / widower / inconsolable) make it the most famous opening in French Romanticism. Vargas plants her murder-mystery inside that literary shadow: one glimmer, held up against the dark.

deep_read.zh: 把整部小说当作对《El Desdichado》的「一束光的注解」来读：留意每次对诗句的引用，都对应凶手布置图景的一次『取景』。
deep_read.en: Read the novel as an extended gloss on El Desdichado's "unique lueur": each quotation is a frame the killer has composed.

deep_read.zh: 追踪银莲花（anémone）与金哨的每一次出现——它们是物件间的坐标，Vargas 惯用「微小信物」串联直觉逻辑。
deep_read.en: Track the anemone and the golden whistle on every appearance — Vargas's small tokens that chain her intuitive logic.

books.why_zh: 当「光荣岁月」被供奉为集体记忆，谁有资格掀开它的阴影——小说与历史，法理与人情。
books.why_en: When the Glory Years are enshrined as collective memory, who is entitled to lift their shadow — fiction and history, law and feeling.

background.zh: 勒梅特「光荣岁月」（Les Années glorieuses）四部曲终章，2026-01-06 出版，512 页，真实 ISBN 9782702191477（旧卡 9782702189825/543pp 已更正）。背景设定在 1963–64 年的巴黎与乡村：长子让·佩尔格（Jean Pelletier）因在火灾中救出一名婴儿而成为国民英雄，被捧为「美丽的承诺」的化身；他的弟弟弗朗索瓦却开始怀疑——这个被全家供奉的英雄，正是连环杀害年轻女性的真凶。经济繁荣的「光辉三十年」遮蔽了道德的溃败：进步的神话与它庇护的罪长自同一根。
background.en: Finale of Lemaitre's Glorious Years quartet, published 2026-01-06, 512 pp, ISBN 9782702191477 (corrected from the wrong 9782702189825/543pp in the earlier card). Set in 1963–64 Paris and the countryside: eldest son Jean Pelletier, a national hero for saving a baby from a fire, becomes the incarnation of "beautiful promises"; his brother François begins to suspect the family's idol is the serial killer of young women. The boom of les Trente Glorieuses masks moral decay — the myth of progress and the crime it shelters grow from the same root.

plot_acts.zh: 巴黎 1963–64。让·佩尔格为救火中婴儿成为国家英雄——媒体造神、「美丽的承诺」全民共情。家中老猫约瑟夫（Joseph）是沉默的观察者。弟弟弗朗索瓦试笔的小说《美丽的承诺》（书名即来自这部「手稿」）把兄长写成连环杀人犯，而现实中蹊跷的失踪案接踵而至。
plot_acts.en: Paris 1963–64. Jean Pelletier becomes a national hero rescuing a baby from a fire — the press canonizes him, "beautiful promises" everywhere. The family cat Joseph is the silent witness. Brother François's manuscript-novel Les Belles Promesses (the real title) imagines the eldest as a serial murderer — then girls really start disappearing.

plot_acts.zh: 弗朗索瓦的怀疑撞上家族的集体回避：母亲热纳维耶芙（Geneviève）持家、弟妹菲利普与科莱特各有城府，全家以「英雄崇拜」为铁律拒绝追问。次线：阿尔及利亚退伍兵曼努埃尔·拉莫斯（Manuel Ramos）的乡村悲剧——被解放的战争创伤与战后「进步」叙事在底层土地上的回响。
plot_acts.en: François's suspicion meets the family's collective refusal to ask: Geneviève keeps the house, siblings Philippe and Colette have agendas, and hero-worship is the rule. Subplot: Manuel Ramos, an Algeria veteran, carries the war's unresolved trauma into the postwar countryside.

plot_acts.zh: 英雄神话与罪行在同一家族体内对质。终局并不给出廉价的救赎：进步年代的账单由谁付？——「光荣岁月」的每一分荣耀都被标了价。
plot_acts.en: The hero-myth and the crime collide inside the same family. No cheap redemption: someone pays for every ounce of the Glory Years' glory.

narrative.zh: 勒梅特的典型声部：高速第三人称、冷峻的黑色幽默、家族史诗的大构架与小景深高密度切换。小说借「书内书」（François 的《美丽的承诺》手稿）制造叙述套盒：作者、角色与读者共享同一份猜疑。
narrative.en: Lemaitre's signature register: rapid third-person, bleak humour, the big family-epic frame cut with dense close-ups. The novel-within-the-novel (François's manuscript) creates a nesting of suspicion shared by author, character and reader.

intent.reception_good_zh: 法媒普遍称赞终章把四部曲收束到「家—历史—正义」三角，猫约瑟夫的设置被反复引用为全书最锋利的意象。
intent.reception_good_en: French media praise the quartet's convergence on family–history–justice; the cat Joseph is repeatedly cited as the sharpest image.
intent.reception_bad_zh: 部分评论认为乡村次线与巴黎主线两线并轨略迟，节奏在第三卷末处偏缓。
intent.reception_bad_en: Some critics find the rural thread converges late; pacing dips near the end of part three.
intent.syn_zh: 作者在 Giscard 时代与「光环三十年」的交汇点写作：真正的主角不是凶手，而是「供奉英雄的家族」这个社会机制。
intent.syn_en: The real protagonist isn't the killer — it's the family-machine that canonizes its hero.

deep_read.zh: 对比「书内书」《美丽的承诺》与真实卷亲戚的互文：勒梅特用同一书名制造的是「读者被布置成共谋者」的阅读体验。
deep_read.en: Read the manuscript-versus-book echo as a trap for the reader-as-accomplice.

background.zh: 佩利科回忆录，2026-02-17 出版（Flammarion，ISBN 9782080497260，320 页），22 种语言同步发行。英译全题《A Hymn to Life: Shame Has to Change Sides》（初传简写 « A Hymn to Life »，NPR 等引用副题）。真实情节底线：回忆录开篇早餐桌小景（作者的早餐鸡蛋/黄油面包与佩尔戈尔德红酒），随后「la vie s'est arrêtée」——2011 年丈夫多米尼克·佩利科开始下药并邀请 50+ 男性在家中强暴她，直至 2020 年 10 月被超市保安在监控中发现其偷拍裙下行为而拆穿。2025-01-21 法国 2 台播出纪录片《Soumission chimique》（非此前纪要所记年份）。
background.en: Pelicot's memoir, published 2026-02-17 (Flammarion, ISBN 9782080497260, 320 pp), released simultaneously in 22 languages. English full title: A Hymn to Life: Shame Has to Change Sides (earlier short form "A Hymn to Life" was used in NPR copy). Reality baseline: the memoir opens as a breakfast-table vignette, then "la vie s'est arrêtée" — from 2011 her husband Dominique Pelicot drugged her and invited 50+ men to rape her at home, exposed in October 2020 by supermarket CCTV capturing him filming up her skirt. France 2's documentary Soumission chimique aired 2025-01-21 (corrected from an earlier recorded year).
background.sources: NPR · bibliotheques.paris · BBC · NYT review · Global Voices · éditeur

plot_acts.zh: 1952-12-07 生于德国菲林根（Villingen），父亲出身德军家庭、入法籍；在硕士格勒诺布尔附近的农场长大（父亲送 Paillards 的马戏团观众）。遇见多米尼克（1971-72）、1973 年四月结婚；卡龙旺（Caronne）祖宅的厨房、烤土豆与蛋奶糊是主妇年代的底色。在 EDF 任物流干部 25 年；2003 年退休在家，2011 年病倒。
plot_acts.en: Born 1952-12-07 in Villingen, Germany to a French-naturalized family; raised on a farm near Grignan (father a traveling-circus vet). Meets Dominique (1971-72), married April 1973; home-cooked dauphinoise in the Caronnes house defines the housewife years. Logistics executive at EDF for 25 years; retires 2003 in the Mazan house; falls ill 2011.

plot_acts.zh: 2011—2020 十年：「拉莫菲斯」深夜体制——麻醉下意识丧失的夜晚，50+ 陌生男子经丈夫安排上门强暴。女儿卡罗琳（Caroline）于 2020 年萌发的「安眠药疑云」、两度在警务站被忽略。2020-10 超市保安发现多米尼克拍摄裙底视频、报警；2020-11-02 佩利科在超市被逮捕。
plot_acts.en: 2011–2020: the nocturnal regime of Temesta — nights of drugged unconsciousness while 50+ men, arranged by her husband, raped her body at their home. Daughter Caroline's 2020 sleeping-powder suspicions — twice dismissed at the police station. October 2020: a supermarket security guard spots Dominique filming up women's skirts and alerts police; 2 Nov 2020, Dominique is arrested.
plot_acts.sources: NPR excerpt · Global Voices · BBC · le monde

plot_acts.zh: 2020-12 Thornyard 搜查发现 4,000+ 影像文件后，佩利科被告知受害数远超已知。她拒绝匿名审判（2024-09-02 公审开始，Avignon/Grand Guignol 法庭）、要求公开布景；终审 2024-12-19 判处多米尼克 20 年、51 名共犯全部或部分定罪。她声明「la honte change de camp」——羞耻易边。2025-01-21 France 2 纪录片；2025-10-08/09 仅 Husamettin D. 上诉（尼姆，加刑一年至 10 年，2025-10-09 判决）；2026-02 出版回忆录。
plot_acts.en: After the 2020-12 Thornyard search finds 4,000+ files, Pelicot learns the true scale. She refuses an anonymous trial (public hearings open 2024-09-02 in Avignon), demands the scenes be shown; verdict 2024-12-19: 20 years for Dominique, most of the 51 co-defendants convicted. "La honte change de camp" — shame must change sides. 2025-01-21 France 2 documentary; 2025-10-08/09 appeal heard in Nîmes for Husamettin D. only, sentenced 10 years (one more than first instance); memoir published Feb 2026.

narrative.zh: 自传体回忆录，第三人称叙述（不经作者亲述而由合著者转写式抻开），以「杯子的边缘」——警察局、法庭、媒体镜头的切面——拼接出一段被麻醉剥夺的十年：记忆的空白、影像的实存、与「我已不是当年的我」之间的裂隙。风格上是佩里尼翁的纪实体（场景法+直接引语），间以佩利科的直接引语作为第一人称「夺回笔」。
narrative.en: A memoir in the co-writing register: third-person narration with Pelicot's quoted first-person voice as the reclaimed pen; scenes cut through police stations, courtrooms and media frames, bridging the void of drugged amnesia and the hard evidence of images.

intent.reception_good_zh: 全球书评聚焦「把 la honte 从受害者移到施害者」的公共意义；英译以全题《A Hymn to Life: Shame Has to Change Sides》传达同一纲领；首周销量 63,574（GfK，法榜第一），印刷 150,000 册，至 2026-03 初约 90,000 册。

intent.reception_bad_zh: 少数保留：部分评论担心「公开化」的再创伤与司法消费边界；另一位观点在法媒零星出现，指称法院记录与回忆录细节差异。
intent.reception_bad_en: Minimal dissent on re-traumatization through publicity and the memoir's place in judicial spectacle.
intent.syn_zh: 关键词是夺回：夺回记忆、夺回姓名、夺回叙述权。与其说是「疗愈之书」，不如说是一部把「被书写者」翻转为「书写者」的文献。
intent.syn_en: This is a reclamation: of memory, of name, of narrative authority — a document that pivots the written-about into the writer.
intent.sources: NPR · BBC · NYT · Global Voices · GfK sales

excerpts.trans_zh: 「教堂之后（2011 起），生活就停止了。」——对受害十年的转折句。
excerpts.note_zh: 「Chapelle」指 2011 年母女住进巴黎近郊的 Chapel 住宅——施害的十年自此开始。「La vie s'est arrêtée」（生活就此停止）：法语句法把「停止」放在最后，像末班车的门在身后关上。佩利科用最朴素的主谓结构说出最重的话——过去时，没有修饰。
excerpts.note_en: "The Chapel" is the house near Paris where the abuse began in 2011. The French sentence ends on the verb 'arrêtée,' snapping shut like a closing door. Pelicot states the heaviest fact in the plainest past tense — no metaphor, which is the point.

excerpts.orig: «On me disait qu'il fallait que je profite de la vie.»
excerpts.trans_zh: 「他们跟我说，要我好好享受生活。」——被麻醉期间的日常讥讽。
excerpts.trans_en: "They told me I had to enjoy life."
excerpts.note_zh: 被麻醉、被侵害期间，人们还在劝她「好好享受生活」。「il fallait que je profite de la vie」——「profiter」在本义上是「利用/享用」：把人生当可得利益。日常话语在此刻的讽刺力，胜过任何控诉。
excerpts.note_en: While she was being drugged and abused, people kept telling her to "make the most of life." The verb "profiter" implies turning life into a benefit. The irony of everyday language here outperforms any indictment — language betrays the speaker.

deep_read.zh: 对照审判笔录与回忆录：注意作者如何在「司法档案」与「文学记忆」两种真实之间运笔——数字（50+ 人、4000+ 影像）与身体感知的并置是其方法。
deep_read.en: Read the memoir against the trial record: watch how numbers (50+ men, 4,000+ files) are set against embodied memory — the method of the book.

deep_read.zh: 重读开篇早餐桌场景与其后的断裂：作者有意让「被杀的就是那个平凡主妇」成为全书的暴力核心。
deep_read.en: Reread the breakfast-table opening and its rupture: the violence is precisely the annihilation of the ordinary housewife.

books.why_zh: 在战争与速度的年份，一本让人放慢到「走到棺材为止」的书——死亡是唯一确定的时间表，读它如同预习。
books.why_en: In a year of war and speed, a book that slows you down to "walk to the coffin" — death is the only certain schedule; reading it is rehearsal.

background.zh: 萬田緑平的第三本非虚构（2025-11-27 幻冬舎新書，224 页，ISBN 9784344987937——旧卡 9784344987934 无效，已更正）。书名取自他实施居家临终关怀时与患者的约定告白——「棺桶まで歩こう」（走到棺材为止）：不是「延长」，而是「陪伴你走到那一天」。核心命题：日本男性「不健康寿命」约 8 年——在宅医师的目标是把这段失能岁月压缩到接近零。发售 2025-11-27 当即成话题书：2026-01-18 六刷 6 万 5 千部，2026-05-08 破 13 万部，2026-07-13 破 15 万部。
background.en: Manda's third nonfiction (Gentosha Shinsho, 2025-11-27, 224 pp, ISBN 9784344987937 — the earlier 9784344987934 is invalid, corrected). The title is his pact with patients under home-hospice care — "walk to the coffin": not prolonging, but walking you to that day. Core thesis: Japanese men's "unhealthy lifespan" runs about 8 years — the home physician's aim is to compress that incapacity toward zero. Released 2025-11-27, it became a talking-point: 65,000 copies by 2026-01-18 (6th printing), 130,000 by 2026-05-08, over 150,000 by 2026-07-13.
background.sources: 幻冬舎新書 · booklog · micin-insurance · note.com · 出版社销售通讯

plot_acts.zh: 序章剖白书名来历：与患者的约定告白、以及作者对「延命治疗 = 延长痛苦」的临床反思。他从外科医生转往在宅缓和ケア的第一手见证。
plot_acts.en: Opening glosses the title as a lived pact and unloads the clinical case against over-extension treatment — a surgeon's first-hand turn to home hospice.

plot_acts.zh: 「步けるうちは死なない」——步行能力是生命力最诚实的指针；每天一段能走的距离，就是身体还能走多远的地图。与之配合的是「每日 8000 步 / 快走 20 分钟」的实证线（中之条研究）。
plot_acts.en: "While you can still walk, you are not yet dying": walking is the honest index of vitality; daily 8,000 steps / 20 brisk minutes is the evidence line.
plot_acts.sources: 目次 · 中对内容广泛转载

plot_acts.zh: 倡导「在家离世」：停止无效治疗、重视心理满足、让死亡回到自家餐桌而非 ICU。对日本男性 8 年「不健康寿命」的批判性拆解——目标是把失能岁月压缩到接近零。
plot_acts.en: For dying at home: stop what no longer serves, honor the psychological, bring death back to the family table. The 8-years-unhealthy-life datum is the book's statistical spine.

plot_acts.zh: 多年在宅看取り的案卷化叙述：家属与患者的心理、临终拒绝进食的「尽孝」陷阱、以及医生如何把「最后一次谈话」讲成日常。
plot_acts.en: Case-driven chapters: family psychology, the feeding-related "filial duty" traps, and how the physician frames the final conversations.
plot_acts.sources: 目次 · 阅读笔记摘引

plot_acts.title_en: Death Is Not the Worst Thing
plot_acts.zh: 全书收束：把死亡从医疗系统的失败项改写为人生的最后一项完成品。作者反复提醒读者——我们与患者的约定，其实也是与自己的约定。
plot_acts.en: The book closes by rewriting death from system-failure into life's final accomplishment — the pact with patients is really a pact with yourself.

narrative.zh: 非虚构随笔体：第一人称的诊疗叙述 + 副题式章首引语 + 与临床心理師東畑開人等人的对谈片段相互穿插。文本节奏刻意放慢——章节既不猎奇也不说教，把「殡葬前的日常」写成人生的一部分。
narrative.en: Nonfiction essay register: first-person clinical narration, epigraph-style chapter openers, interspersed dialogues (e.g. with clinical psychologist Kaito Higata). The pace is deliberately slow — the deathbed is written as part of ordinary life.

excerpts.orig: 「今日も歩けたね。棺桶まで、もう少しだ。」
excerpts.trans_zh: 「今天也走得动了呢。到棺材为止，就差一点了。」
excerpts.trans_en: "We made it again today. Just a little closer to the coffin."
excerpts.note_zh: 书名《棺桶まで歩こう》（走到棺材为止）的第一引线：把死说成「通往棺材的路」——不是终点，而是每天早上还能「再走一天」的度量。日语习惯用「今日も歩けたね」(今天也走得动啊)温柔地互勉：向死而生的语调，是日语介护文化的底色。
excerpts.note_en: The novel's title-phrase: death as "the road to the coffin" — not an end but the measure of one more day walked. The gentle "we made it again today" is the standard cadence of Japanese care culture: living-toward-death spoken in the ordinary voice of a morning greeting.

deep_read.zh: 把它与 Gawande《Being Mortal》对照读：日本在宅缓和ケア的传统为对象，与美式临终关怀的两套体制对话。
deep_read.en: Read against Being Mortal: the Japanese home-care tradition in conversation with Gawande's American hospice debate.

deep_read.zh: 注意作者对「数字」的态度——以 8 年不健康寿命等统计数据为坐标，但拒绝以 QALY 式功利计算为终点。
deep_read.en: Notice how stats (the 8-year figure) are used as coordinates, never as QALY-style utility endpoints.
